summary.name: Dictámelo
summary.one_liner: Dictámelo is an open-source AI dictation app that types what you speak into any application, with offline local models or optional cloud transcription.
use_cases: clean up spoken drafts with filler word removal
write emails or prompts by voice
summary.what_it_does: Dictámelo lets you hold a shortcut (Alt/⌥ + Shift + space is shown) in any app, speak, and release so the text appears at the cursor. It can run local speech models such as Whisper, Parakeet v3 and Canary 180M Flash after you download them, which the page says work without an account or internet and process audio on your device. Optional AI cleanup removes filler words and applies spoken corrections, and a custom vocabulary lets you add names and terms. It can also transcribe dropped-in audio files, and offers Dictámelo Cloud or your own provider keys for cloud processing.
notable: Runs local Whisper, Parakeet and Canary models for offline dictation
Source code on GitHub under the MIT license
Optional AI cleanup that sends only text to the cloud when permitted
Custom vocabulary and audio file transcription
caveats: Languages and speed depend on the model and the user's device
Cloud use follows the chosen provider's rates and limits
AI cleanup is optional and needs the user's permission to send text to the cloud
